stable_traits.age: over forty years as a Darkfriend
stable_traits.personality: abject, debased, degraded, vile beyond measure; greedy for rewards; terrified of his master; willing to betray anyone; driven by compulsion to hunt his targets

factions.name: The Shadow
factions.notes: Darkfriend for over forty years; transformed by the Dark One into a hound for hunting; compelled to hunt Rand, Mat, and Perrin

aliases_observed.notes: Description of his role after being changed at Shayol Ghul

characters.notes: Fain has been transformed by the Dark One in ways that make him something worse than an ordinary Darkfriend. He was taken to Shayol Ghul three years ago and changed to hunt the three ta'veren. He is now imprisoned in Fal Dara's cells.

stable_traits.filiations: brother of King al'Akir Mandragoran; husband of Breyan; acclaimed hero
stable_traits.personality: bold, reckless; close as a twin to his brother al'Akir

factions.name: Malkier
factions.notes: King's brother; led forces into the Blight

characters.notes: Historical figure. Led his lances through the Blight to the Blasted Lands on a dare from his wife Breyan, and died there with most of his men. His death was a key event in the fall of Malkier.

stable_traits.filiations: last crowned King of the Malkieri; father of Lan; brother of Lain; husband of el'Leanna
stable_traits.personality: such a man and king as comes once in a hundred years; close as a twin to his brother Lain; wept when he killed his friend Cowin

factions.name: Malkier
factions.notes: Last crowned King of the Malkieri

characters.notes: Historical figure. Lan's father. Died at Herat's Crossing defending Malkier against the Shadow.

stable_traits.filiations: wife of Lain Mandragoran; mother of Isam
stable_traits.personality: jealous, envious; burned with envy that al'Akir was raised to throne instead of Lain; plotted treason for revenge

factions.name: The Shadow
factions.notes: Plotted with Cowin Gemallan to seize the throne; conspired with a Darkfriend

characters.notes: Historical figure. Fled with her infant son Isam when the plot failed; run down by Trollocs. Her jealousy and plotting were instrumental in the fall of Malkier.

stable_traits.age: infant at time of fall of Malkier
stable_traits.filiations: son of Lain Mandragoran and Breyan

characters.notes: Historical figure. Infant son of Lain and Breyan. His mother fled with him when her plot failed; they were run down by Trollocs. Their fate is uncertain but can be guessed.

stable_traits.filiations: one of the Great Lords of Malkier
stable_traits.personality: jealous; never forgot that he nearly became king; hero turned traitor

factions.notes: Darkfriend who plotted with Breyan to seize the throne

Short form of his hero name

characters.notes: Historical figure. Darkfriend and traitor. One of the Great Lords of Malkier, came within two votes of being king. Plotted with Breyan, stripped the Borderforts, allowing Trolloc invasion. Captured by Jain Charin and slain in single combat by King al'Akir.

stable_traits.personality: heroic; already called Farstrider in his youth

aliases_observed.notes: Already called this when he captured Cowin Fairheart

characters.notes: Historical context: captured Cowin Fairheart and brought him to the Seven Towers in chains. This is the same person as Jain Farstrider from the roster.

stable_traits.filiations: Queen of Malkier; wife of al'Akir; mother of Lan

characters.notes: Historical figure. Lan's mother. With her husband, consecrated infant Lan as Dai Shan and next King of Malkier. Died at Herat's Crossing.

This appears to be the name of a location (a Waygate) near Fal Dara, not a character. However, given the context of Ogier naming conventions, it might be an Ogier name for a stedding or grove. Treating cautiously as potentially a place-name rather than a character.

appearances.whereabouts: Fal Dara, in a dining chamber
appearances.notable_actions: Paces restlessly, counting strides; worries about what Fain is telling Moiraine; listens to Agelmar's story about Lan; learns that Fain has been hunting him for three years; realizes the Dark One has been pursuing him specifically
appearances.demeanor: restless, anxious, irritable; discovers himself keeping tally unconsciously; feels a chill at learning he's been hunted for three years but wonders why it doesn't frighten him more

appearances.whereabouts: Fal Dara, in the dining chamber
appearances.notable_actions: Crumbles bread and pushes crumbs around absently; stares unfocused; remembers Fain's strange behavior three springs ago; asks if Fain followed them through the Ways
appearances.demeanor: distant, preoccupied, staring at nothing; yellow eyes unfocused; seems to see something far off; appears unsurprised by revelations

appearances.whereabouts: Fal Dara, in the dining chamber
appearances.notable_actions: Slouches in chair; unconsciously touches the Shadar Logoth dagger through his coat repeatedly; knocks his chair over in frustration; curses softly; remembers Fain's odd behavior; opens mouth to speak and shuts it at Rand's look
appearances.demeanor: nervous, grinning nervously (not with amusement); restless; frustrated; cursing; hand constantly straying to his dagger

appearances.whereabouts: Fal Dara, in the dining chamber
appearances.notable_actions: Studies the stone walls of the room closely; stands in the middle turning slowly in a circle; presses his nose against the stone while tracing joins with his fingers; closes his eyes to feel the stone; mutters to himself in Ogier; listens intently to Moiraine's revelations; speaks of Manetheren as most beautiful except for Tar Valon; whispers 'The Light preserve us' when learning of Fain and the Black Wind
appearances.demeanor: absorbed in examining the architecture; not worried unlike the others; fascinated by the stonework; reverent when speaking of Manetheren; horrified at mention of Fain understanding the Black Wind

appearances.whereabouts: Fal Dara, in the dining chamber
appearances.notable_actions: Laughs at Agelmar's stories; listens closely to the tale of Lan's past; stares into her cup looking troubled after hearing Lan's history; avoids looking at Lan when he enters; tightens her mouth at Mat's cursing; glares at Mat; shakes her head at Rand indicating she has not told Moiraine about his origins
appearances.demeanor: initially amused by Agelmar's stories; becomes troubled and pale after learning of Lan's tragic past; deliberately avoids looking at Lan; disapproving of Mat's language

appearances.whereabouts: Fal Dara, in the dining chamber
appearances.notable_actions: Giggles at Agelmar's stories; asks about Lan's identity and titles; listens to the story of Malkier; puts a sympathetic hand on Nynaeve's arm; gasps when learning Fain brought Trollocs to Emond's Field; asks why Fain would do that; questions about Fain escaping the Black Wind; raises an eyebrow at Mat
appearances.demeanor: initially cheerful and entertained; becomes somber and sympathetic as she learns darker truths; shocked at revelations about Fain; concerned for Nynaeve

appearances.whereabouts: Fal Dara, in the dining chamber as host
appearances.notable_actions: Tells stories to entertain Nynaeve and Egwene; relates the full history of Lan and the fall of Malkier with pride and sadness; calls Rand, Mat, and Perrin 'country oafs'; questions Moiraine's learning from Fain; offers to get information from Fain through harsh means; argues that the party should wait to learn more; offers to replace the young men with experienced soldiers; stares in shock when learning the farmboys will fight at the Eye; initially reaches for his sword in alarm; slowly accepts Moiraine's explanation about the old blood of Manetheren
appearances.demeanor: hospitable and entertaining at first; shows fatherly pride when speaking of Lan; contemptuous of the idea the Dark One was loose; sick-looking when Lan confirms evil fought evil at Shadar Logoth; stubborn in arguing for caution; shocked and disbelieving that farmboys are ta'veren; gradually accepting

appearances.whereabouts: Interviews Fain, then returns to the dining chamber
appearances.notable_actions: Interrogates Padan Fain; asks for washbasin and washes her hands vigorously in steaming water; reveals everything Fain told her about his transformation by the Dark One, his hunting of the three boys, and his journey; explains Fain was chosen and changed at Shayol Ghul three years ago; describes how Fain was made into the Dark One's hound; reveals Fain brought the Trollocs to Emond's Field; explains the Waygate at Manetheren and orders it sealed; describes Fain's compulsion and suffering; says Fain knows something about the Eye of the World but won't reveal it; tells Agelmar they must leave immediately; insists the three young men are ta'veren and must go to the Eye; invokes the old blood of Manetheren
appearances.demeanor: feels soiled and degraded from contact with Fain; determined; urgent about the need to leave; drained by what she did with Fain; gentle but firm with Agelmar; implacable in her insistence on taking the boys; studying Rand and his friends, weighing their strength

appearances.whereabouts: With Moiraine during the interview with Fain, then returns to the dining chamber
appearances.notable_actions: Accompanies Moiraine to interview Fain; returns with her; confirms that Fain was the one he sensed following them; states that something drove four Fades to Shadar Logoth
appearances.demeanor: observant, matter-of-fact in discussing the threat

appearances.whereabouts: Imprisoned in the cells below Fal Dara, being interrogated by Moiraine
appearances.notable_actions: Is interrogated by Moiraine; reveals (under compulsion) his entire history: taken to Shayol Ghul three years ago, transformed by Ba'alzamon, sent to hunt in the Two Rivers area, found the three boys in Emond's Field, marked them, guided the Trolloc attack, was forced to run with Trollocs and threatened with being cooked, crossed the Taren, was leashed by a Myrddraal and dragged behind them, led the Myrddraal back to Shadar Logoth, fled the city, was driven by compulsion to keep hunting, could not eat or stop, felt his quarry from a mile away, followed them into the Ways, murdered the shop owner in Caemlyn, was caught by the Black Wind but it fled from him; clamped his jaws shut when the Eye of the World was mentioned; screamed often of fire and burning; hides something important despite Moiraine's efforts
appearances.demeanor: terrified, debased, abject; screaming; whimpering when speaking of Shadar Logoth; trying to hide knowledge; shattered and ruined by torture; greedy for promised rewards showing through at times

appearances.whereabouts: Mentioned as having appeared at Shayol Ghul and in dreams
appearances.notable_actions: Summoned Fain to Shayol Ghul three years ago; transformed Fain with fire and burning; set Fain to hunt; commanded Fain through dreams two years ago; came to Fain in a dream in Lugard and demanded rites; promised Fain great rewards and power; appeared at Shadar Logoth as a flickering projection that vanished and reappeared; drove four Myrddraal into Shadar Logoth; burned Fain's hands when he tried to resist opening the Waygate; has walked in dreams of those who live in the Light this year
appearances.demeanor: described as having eyes of fire; terrifying; powerful; the source of Fain's torture and compulsion

appearances.whereabouts: Historical: led forces through the Blight to the Blasted Lands
appearances.notable_actions: Led his lances through the Blight on a dare from his wife Breyan; died in the Blasted Lands with most of his men; this weakened Malkier critically
appearances.demeanor: remembered as acclaimed for his deeds, close as a twin to his brother

appearances.whereabouts: Historical: ruled Malkier, died at Herat's Crossing
appearances.notable_actions: Ruled as King of Malkier; with his Queen brought infant Lan to them in his cradle; placed the sword of Malkieri kings in Lan's infant hands; anointed Lan's head with oil, naming him Dai Shan; consecrated Lan as next King; swore the ancient oath over Lan; gave Lan over to twenty of his Bodyguard with orders to carry him to Fal Moran; faced Cowin Gemallan in single combat and slew him, weeping; led the Malkieri against the Shadow at Herat's Crossing and died there
appearances.demeanor: remembered as a man and king such as comes once in a hundred years; wept when he killed his friend Cowin

appearances.whereabouts: Historical: plotted in Malkier, then fled south
appearances.notable_actions: Made the dare that sent Lain into the Blight, motivated by envy; blamed al'Akir for Lain's death; plotted with Cowin Gemallan to seize the throne for her son Isam; moved soldiers back from the Blight to seize the Seven Towers; fled south with infant Isam when the plot failed; was run down by Trollocs
appearances.demeanor: envious, jealous, vengeful, treacherous

appearances.whereabouts: Historical: fled with his mother Breyan
appearances.notable_actions: Was the intended beneficiary of his mother's plot to seize the throne; fled with Breyan; fate uncertain after being run down by Trollocs
appearances.demeanor: an infant; innocent victim

appearances.whereabouts: Historical: plotted in Malkier, captured and executed
appearances.notable_actions: Plotted with Breyan to seize the throne; was a Darkfriend; moved soldiers back from the Blight, stripping Borderforts to bare garrisons; allowed Trolloc invasion of Malkier; was captured by Jain Charin and brought to Seven Towers in chains; was slain in single combat by King al'Akir
appearances.demeanor: jealous, traitorous; remembered as having been a hero before his treachery

appearances.whereabouts: Historical: captured Cowin Gemallan in Malkier
appearances.notable_actions: Captured Cowin Fairheart and brought him in chains to the Seven Towers
appearances.demeanor: heroic; already called Farstrider

appearances.whereabouts: Historical: ruled as Queen of Malkier, died at Herat's Crossing
appearances.notable_actions: With her husband brought infant Lan to them; wrapped Lan in swaddling clothes by her own hand; placed a locket around Lan's neck for remembrance; gave Lan to twenty of the King's Bodyguard; led the Malkieri against the Shadow at Herat's Crossing and died there
appearances.demeanor: loving mother; determined ruler; died defending her people

appearances.whereabouts: Mentioned as having been at Emond's Field and other locations in the past
appearances.notable_actions: Failed at Emond's Field; brought Fain with the Trollocs on the trail; would not let Fain ride with him; forced Fain to run with Trollocs; another Fade found Fain before Baerlon and was less kind; made Fain sleep in a Trolloc kettle; used Fain as far as Shadar Logoth; four returned to Shadar Logoth driven by something or someone
appearances.demeanor: cruel to Fain; disbelieving of Fain's tracking ability at first

appearances.whereabouts: Not present in this chapter; mentioned in context of past journeys
appearances.notable_actions: None in this chapter
appearances.demeanor: Not applicable
